theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_tr_scaling_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (D : ℝ → ℝ) (E G : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (R K C : ℝ), 0 < R → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), E s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * G s) → (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), G s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s ^ n)) → (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ‖D r‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * ENNReal.ofReal K * E (R * r)) → Tendsto D (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
